eligibility: US bank account (Plaid-compatible), valid SSN or ITIN, government-issued ID; approval based on bank-account cash flow, not credit score. Balance auto-paid weekly from the linked bank account.
biggest_catch: Tomo is a credit-building charge card with no signup bonus and no rewards program — there is no official cash mechanism at all, and its credit limit is borrowing power, not money.
catches: No sign-up bonus: Tomo's card offers no welcome bonus and (per 2026 reviews) removed its cashback rewards in late 2024.
The credit limit is borrowing power based on your bank-account cash flow — borrowing is not income and never counts as money.
2026 reviews report a $2.99/month membership fee (~$35.88/year), so the card can cost you money rather than make you any.
Balances are auto-deducted weekly; if your bank balance cannot cover the payment, the card freezes until paid in full.
Credit-building only helps indirectly (better credit profile over time); it puts no cash in your pocket.
